title: Ann Arbor Research Site (Broken Dawn)
summary: The source-specific Ann Arbor research destination in Broken Dawn, where a possible broad-spectrum antiviral becomes the focus of the novel's Mantis-directed conflict.

claims.text: Broken Dawn's published premise directs its protagonists toward a Midwest research lead involving a potential broad-spectrum antiviral.
The licensed novel places the Ann Arbor research lead under threat from the operation coordinated through the Mantis codename.

paragraphs.text: The Ann Arbor research site is a Broken Dawn location, not a confirmed playable game space. It matters because the novel's published antiviral lead becomes a target for competing groups.

The novel's source-specific conflict puts the research site at risk from a Mantis-directed operation. That does not identify the handler's organization or convert the location into a confirmed Black Tusk facility.

verification.notes: Source-specific licensed-novel location. Its relationship to a real-world city does not make the fictional research operation a real-world claim.
